'''Oryel Taakses''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pinett]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While Taakses served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an informant, he put his ties to his family above his affiliation to the Empire and he was particularly fond of his uncle, [[Daetan Taakses]].
